alignments.note: Verb takes its auxiliary; the explicit subject noun stands in its own units (rule 17).
Article on מִזְבֵּחַ takes the written *the*; briefing glosses on s006-s008 are shifted and the morphology governs (rule 39).
Verbless clause: the supplied *it is* joins this predicate nominal (rule 20) and the supplied *the* joins the noun (rules 15, 29).
Rectum takes *of* (rule 19), rendered *the offering made by fire* and headed on *fire* (rule 31); *offering* was the competing head.
Indefinite *a* belongs to the nominal (rule 15); unit discontinuous around *sweet*.
No article morpheme here, so the supplied *the* joins the noun (rule 15).

The ASV writes no English preposition for the possessive לְ: its relation stands inside the genitive *Jehovah’s*, so the preposition and the name share one unit under rule 30’s one-rendering condition, and the construction-supplied copula *is* joins that fused unit exactly as it joins לִפְנֵי -> *was before* there (rules 20, 49). Head on the lexeme-bearing name. Splitting the pair — *is* to the preposition, *Jehovah’s* to the name — is the competing reading, rejected because that split leaves the לְ holding a copula the construction supplies rather than any rendering of its own relation, and because the corpus fuses לְ + the divine name in all six comparable units (EXO.9.29 *is Jehovah’s*, EXO.13.12 *shall be Jehovah’s*, ISA.44.5 *am Jehovah’s*, 1SA.17.47, EXO.12.11, EXO.12.27). Recording it `noncompositional` instead was also available; `aligned` follows EXO.9.29, the closest parallel, and this chapter’s own לִפְנֵי units.

review_notes: *all the fat is Jehovah’s*: לַיהוָה is one fused unit carrying the construction’s copula (rules 30, 49), headed on *Jehovah’s*; the split reading and the `noncompositional` status are both named in that unit’s note. Corrected at chapter reconciliation, where the chapter’s uniform fusion of לִפְנֵי and לְעֻמַּת and the corpus precedent were both in view.
Glosses on the altar’s three morphemes are reversed in the briefing (rule 39).
אִשֶּׁה headed on *fire* by rule 31’s subtraction test, as in vv. 3, 5, 9, 11 and 14; *offering* remains defensible and is named in the unit’s note.
